name: Open Anatomy Explorer (OPANEX)
what_it_is: A web-based, open-source 3D anatomy atlas viewer built with Angular and WebGL, offering separate student and instructor UIs for uploading, labelling, and quizzing on anatomical models.
configuration: Keycloak Helm chart with realm roles
modes: Instructor mode (upload, label, create quizzes, import/export)
constraints: Requires Kubernetes cluster with ingress controller
Container images must be pre-built and pushed
Keycloak realm requires manual configuration of roles and OIDC clients
